answer: Picture a raven that wants to flood a jury with puppet graders. Each new identity must post a slashable bond before its quill can score anyone, and jurors are drawn at random, so puppets rarely sit on the same case. When a puppet scores far from the honest median, its bond burns. A fake swarm launched like a comet therefore pays one full bond per puppet up front and loses most of them within a few epochs, while honest graders earn theirs back.
